visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. The KB-era index.html that used to sit in this directory was DELETED 2026-08-27: it was retired as a visual target on 2026-08-26 and kept only because ci:mockup-coverage required a parity.json beside any index.html, which is a gate keeping a dead file alive. The target is the patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. THIS FILE STILL BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Utility comparison page: side-by-side property table. noindex — not an SEO surface. The landing state is the competitive surface: Redfin and Zillow open their compare screens on the visitor's own saved thumbnails, and this page has no saved-homes rail to open on. It wins instead by showing the finished object to a visitor who arrives with nothing — four real homes for sale right now, in the real table, labelled as an example, each one a single tap into their own comparison.
note: E-HOMES-SEARCH 2026-08-13. Migrated /compare chrome onto the v3 barrel. Chrome: layout mounts V3Chrome (sticky, in flow). This page does not remount it. V3Breadcrumb belowNav=false. V3Footer outside <main>. Page contract carried unchanged: robots noindex,follow, revalidate 60, canonical /compare, DAL fetch (getListingTiles by listNumbers AND listingKeys, dedup, getListingDetailPhotos), CompareClient props, BreadcrumbList JSON-LD, V3SectionTracker pageType=compare. Shared /compare?ids= links keep resolving. Dual objectives unchanged. Capture does not live on this route. KB-era deletions: SmoothScrollProvider, KbBreadcrumb, KbFooter, kb-root, kb.css, navy header band. AICompare deleted 2026-08-18 (never wired). MetadataBlock and KbSectionTracker stay on non-v3 registers. SITE-50 (2026-09-09): the empty state left V3Quiet for V3Slots, a new barrel pattern. The taste table scored this class 29 with the verdict 'an empty form label, not a product demo'; Quiet has no slot, no table and no figure by contract, so the fix could never be a prop on Quiet. Two more defects were fixed in the same change: the H1 sat in a bare <header> with no measure and no gutter and was clipped at x=0 at both 1440 and 375, and the visually-hidden spans inside the new table escaped their scroll container (no positioned ancestor) and made the document scroll sideways at 375 — html.scrollWidth 602 against a 375 viewport. SITE-95 (2026-09-15): the worked example moved off the hand-drawn table V3Slots used to carry and onto the installed catalog source. app/compare/_v3/CompareSheet.client.tsx imports @/components/ui/table (real data-slot rows, hover, data-state=selected) and @/components/ui/carousel (embla, one photo rail per home with the kit's own prev/next), painted navy/cream in app/compare/_v3/compare-sheet.css through v3 tokens only — the same shape app/invest/_v3/InvestTables.client.tsx uses. V3Slots keeps the pattern (headline, claim, visible SAMPLE label, tray, section 0 trace) and takes the sheet as a node; its own table, photo stamps, hairline bars and four outline Add buttons are deleted, not restyled. Rows went 8 to 9 (garage), every row carries a bar and the two extremes are marked on the field being read, the reading line over the sheet states that field's spread across all four homes, and at 375 a picker carries two homes at a time instead of cropping the second column through its own address. Photographs read through getListingPhotos, not getListingDetailPhotos: listing_photos held no row for any of the four newest active listings on 2026-09-15 (checked broad and by exact key), so the strip had nothing to page. SEO: ItemList JSON-LD naming the four sampled homes at their canonical listing URLs beside the BreadcrumbList, a description that names the fields, and the search door restored as a real anchor.

The open states are --states 'carousel-open=[data-slot="carousel-next"]@#compare-empty!click,table-open=[data-compare-row="Price / sq ft"]@#compare-empty!click', which click the installed control and frame the section it changes.

tasteReview.beats: A portal-style side-by-side compare table (Redfin/Zillow's own compare-homes grid) — this page wins on the interpretive sentence at the top that recomputes the spread ('$1,475,100 apart, 369% more') when a row is tapped, which turns a bare grid into a sentence a buyer can actually parse. It does not yet beat the portals on breadth (no schools, walk score, or scheduling inline) or on visual distinctiveness — it is the same table shape, just narrated.

defects.finding: carousel-open-desktop.png and carousel-open-mobile375.png are pixel-identical to the closed shots except a second chevron fading in on the first card. No slide advances to photo 2, no dot indicator changes state, no drag affordance is visible — there is no evidence the shadcn Carousel interaction (click/drag to move between multiple photos per listing) actually functions; it reads as a static hero frame with hover-revealed chrome, not the demo rail.

Hero label/heading, SAMPLE banner, stat sentence, tab pills, four-photo row, bar-chart table — every piece is correct and on-brand but the shape is a generic spec-comparison utility (the same layout a laptop-comparison or appliance-comparison template would produce). Nothing here is a choice distinct enough that a visitor would screenshot it.

defects.section: SHOWING 4 OF 4 tabs (desktop) vs PICK TWO tabs (mobile)
defects.finding: The selection control's label and behavior change across breakpoints with no visible explanation: desktop shows all four homes permanently active with no deselect affordance, mobile hard-caps at two with different copy. It reads as two unfinished states of the same control rather than one deliberate responsive interaction.

tasteReview.verdict: This is a competent, correctly-branded utility page — navy/cream, Amboqia display headline, tabular numerals, and one confirmed real interaction (tapping a row recomputes the spread sentence above the table) — but it stops at correct. demoMatch is false: the carousel's *-open capture shows no confirmed slide change, only a hover-revealed second arrow, so the shadcn Carousel interaction is unverified from these shots and reads as a photo strip wearing carousel chrome. No named TASTE.md tell fires outright (the numeric rows are bar-encoded, not a bare scrolling list; the stat line is a sentence, not a KPI grid), but the page is dull in the way that costs the most here: nothing in the composition is a choice this template wouldn't have made on its own.
tasteReview.rebaselineReason: All three instrument keys differ from the prior mark. evaluatorModel: claude-sonnet-5 through the claude CLI, because no grok CLI exists in this cloud sandbox (the 2026-09-10 mark was grok-4.6). rubricVersion: v1-2026-09-12, which added the blocking demoMatch rule and the replaceWith option list (the prior mark was v1-2026-09-08). shotsHash: six new first-viewport shots of the rebuilt page off the PRODUCTION build, including the two open states this rubric requires, against the prior two. The 2026-09-12 taste table's own row for this class (median 46, grok-4.6, v1-2026-09-12, demoMatch false) is a third instrument again. This kit publishes no structured competitiveBrief, so the judge's competitiveBriefPass is recorded as returned and binds nothing. Mechanical accept holds: four listing photographs at 253 CSS px, four prices, the label row and two comparison rows with their bars and LOWEST/HIGHEST marks are in the 1440 fold; two homes, their photographs, the label row and the first comparison row are in the 375 fold; no dashed empty Add-a-home tray anywhere. contentFloor measured on that build: h1 1, words 305, headings 0, sections 2, internalLinks 168, images 13, heroImageWidth 253, heroImageNatural 1536, video 0, jsonLd 4 — every floor held and jsonLd rose by the ItemList.
